+            if not (0 <= yy < skel.shape[0] and 0 <= xx < skel.shape[1]) or not skel[yy, xx]:

+            # A diagonal touching the same orthogonal run would form a false 3-cycle.
+            if dx and dy and (skel[y, xx] or skel[yy, x]):

+def trace_skeleton(skel: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """One continuous depth-first walk that visits the connected skeleton."""
+    points = list(zip(*np.where(skel)))
+    graph = {p: neighbors(p, skel) for p in points}
+    ends = [p for p in points if len(graph[p]) == 1]
+    start = min(ends) if ends else min(points)

+    route: list[tuple[int, int]] = []

+        seen.add(p)
+        route.append(p)
+        for q in sorted(graph[p]):
+            if q == parent or q in seen:
